messages:
ingrid: Hey team, customer cust-1045 reporting repeated 429s on the /v1/rerank endpoint starting ~14:03 UTC. They say it started after a deploy that increased candidate list size.

maria: Any error body? 429 with X-RateLimit headers?

ingrid: Here's what they pasted:

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
  "message": "Rerank quota exceeded for account",
  "retry_after": 12
}
```
They also included the request body: `{"query": "...", "candidates": [200 items]}`

alex: 200 candidates is a lot. Rerank cost scales with num_candidates * avg_len. That can blow past their per-minute rerank quota quickly.

jordan: Confirmed - checked rate logs for cust-1045: spike in 'rerank_token_units' at 14:02. They went from ~500 units/min to ~12k units/min. We show `x-rate-limit-remaining: 0` around that time.

ingrid: They said they toggled retries on the client (retries=3) at the same time, so retry storms likely compounded it.

ops-oncall: @ingrid can you grab trace ids from their 429 responses? We need to match on server traces.

ingrid: Sent customer note asking for a sample curl with the candidate count + any trace id. They responded with one trace id: `trace-0a9f4b`.

support-bot: Ticket INC-28912 created and linked to this thread.

alex: Repro steps I used locally:

```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank" \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"query":"weather","candidates": ["a","b", ... repeated 200 times]}'
```
I get 429 after ~8 requests when retries are enabled.

jordan: For remediation: 1) ask customer to reduce candidates to <= 50; 2) add exponential backoff (jitter) on retries; 3) consider a quota bump while they test.

maria: I'll run a temporary quota increase for cust-1045: +2x rerank units for 2 hours, monitor. If that doesn't stabilize we'll enforce per-client concurrent request limits.

ingrid: Customer accepted the mitigation and will roll candidate pruning. They also asked if there's an SDK option to pre-filter.

alex: Recommend using our client-side candidate prefilter example (see internal doc: /docs/rerank-prefilter) and sampling. Also note we may add server-side soft-limits in future to return 429 with `x-rw-suggested-candidates`.

ops-oncall: I've attached log snippets for trace-0a9f4b to INC-28912 for debugging. No sign of other errors.

maria: Quota bump applied at 14:20 UTC. Remaining refunds: none needed. Monitoring metrics now show rate back to baseline.

ingrid: Customer confirmed they pruned candidates and disabled aggressive retries. :thumbsup:

jordan: Follow-up action: update support KB to call out rerank cost model and recommend defaults (max_candidates=50, exponential backoff). I'll make a PR.

ingrid: Closing loop with customer now. Thanks everyone.
